== Notes ==
* Can provide defense against other damage types when used with skills that convert damage to elemental damage, such as [[Stone Striker]], [[Conflagration]], and [[Greater Conflagration]].
* The AI cannot detect a ward's presence. While remaining inside would be favourable, even flagged NPCs characters will run out of its protection whenever hit.
